title_en: Why Does This Egg Start Spinning Again?
title_zh: 蛋明明停了，為什麼又轉起來？

cues.en: Briefly stop these two spinning eggs. Let go right away. Only one starts turning again.
cues.zh: 短暫按停兩顆正在轉的蛋，立刻放手。只有一顆又開始轉。
captions_en: Briefly stop these two spinning eggs.
captions_zh: 短暫按停兩顆正在轉的蛋，立刻放手。
cues.scene: Overhead illustrated demo. Two marked egg shells spin, both marks stop visibly, then only one resumes after release.

cues.en: The hard-boiled egg stays still. The raw egg starts turning again. The difference is what's inside.
cues.zh: 熟蛋停在原地，生蛋又轉了起來。差別就在蛋殼裡。
captions_en: The raw egg starts turning again.
captions_zh: 熟蛋停在原地，生蛋又轉了起來。
cues.scene: Same position. Labels appear; only raw egg turns briefly again.

cues.en: In the hard-boiled egg, the solid inside and the shell turn together. Stop the shell, and the whole egg stops.
cues.zh: 熟蛋裡面是固態，和蛋殼一起轉。按住蛋殼，整顆蛋就停下來。
captions_en: In the hard-boiled egg, the solid

Stop the shell, and the whole egg stops.
captions_zh: 熟蛋裡面是固態，和蛋殼一起轉。
按住蛋殼，整顆蛋就停下來。
cues.scene: Close cross-section. Solid core mark and shell mark rotate and stop together.

cues.en: In the raw egg, a brief touch stops the shell while the liquid inside is still turning.
cues.zh: 短暫按住生蛋，蛋殼停了，裡面的液體還在轉。

captions_zh: 短暫按住生蛋，蛋殼停了，
cues.scene: Same angle and scale. Shell mark stops; arrow continues turning inside.

cues.en: Let go right away, and the moving liquid drags the shell around again.
cues.zh: 立刻放手，還在轉的液體就會帶動蛋殼再轉一下。

cues.scene: Release. Same shell marker starts moving in the same direction; fluid loses speed.

cues.en: Hold it still for longer, and the liquid slows down too. That little restart only happens if there's still motion inside.
cues.zh: 如果按住久一點，液體也會慢下來。裡面還在轉，蛋殼才會再轉一下。

cues.scene: Alternative long hold labeled. Inner arrow slows with shell held; fully stopped case ends with both still. End in original comparison layout.

sources.supports: Matched experiment and opposite outcomes on immediate release; moving liquid restarts the shell.
Stop and release immediately; in the raw egg the liquid continues moving independently of the shell.
When the shell stops momentarily, the liquid interior can keep rotating. The article discusses this as inertia rather than displaying a measured spin-down curve.
Step 9 calls for a brief touch and prompt release. The animation extends an alternative hold to show the qualitative consequence of drag at a stationary shell.
Internal friction tends to bring the liquid and shell toward the same rotation rate. Together with the short-touch demonstrations, this supports the long-hold comparison as qualitative inference.
